The handoff tells me WHICH way each resolves without waiting for the print: when the prior bounce is MATURE and closed strong-but-into-a-bearish-print (0319, close_off_low 0.97 but chain-sided injection ahead) the up-carry is a fade and the chain-sided print delivers its band DOWN; when the prior bounce already FADED in its last hour inside a still-down chain (0325 -> 0326, last_hour dir/flow both -1, chain_polarity -1) the counter-print up-leg is a terminal push that round-trips. In BOTH cases the rule is the same and it is the doctrine rule: size the seam up-carry by the PRIOR day's EXHAUSTION state, never by the raw close-near-high or the raw onset_dir=up (which are identical on both days and non-discriminating). The prior-close last-hour flow-vs-direction is the leading tell - it fired the 0325->0326 round-trip a full session before the phase2 absorption confirmed it, and (as my 0326 handoff_out flags) the SAME last_hour_signed_flow-vs-direction lens turns positive-under-falling into the 0327 expiry covering-coil. Recommend forward-testing 'prior-close last_hour_signed_flow vs last_hour_dir as an overnight-seam exhaustion/coil tell' on G16/G17.
